+         component:

+     },
+     // Show the component in both light and dark mode

+   },
+   decorators: [

+   ],
+   tags: ['autodocs'],
+ } satisfies Meta&lt;typeof DemoDrawerUnderlay&gt;
+ 
+ export default meta
+ type Story = StoryObj&lt;typeof meta&gt;
+ 
+ export const Default: Story = {
+   args: {},
+   parameters: {
+     docs: {
+       description: {
+         story: 'Default drawer underlay with full functionality.',
+       },
+     },
+   },
+ }
+ 
+ export const Mobile: Story = {
+   parameters: {
+     viewport: {
+       defaultViewport: 'mobile1',
+     },
+     docs: {
+       description: {
+         story: 'Drawer component displayed on a mobile viewport.',

+     },
+   },
+ }
+ 
+ export const Tablet: Story = {

+ // Interactive demo with a play function
+ export const Interactive: Story = {
+   parameters: {
+     docs: {
+       description: {
+         story:
+           'An interactive demonstration showing the drawer being expanded and collapsed by clicking the action buttons.',
+       },
+     },
+   },
+   play: async ({canvasElement}) =&gt; {
+     const canvas = within(canvasElement)
+ 
+     // Wait for the component to fully render
+     await new Promise((resolve) =&gt; setTimeout(resolve, 500))
+ 
+     // Find the close button (X) and click it to collapse the drawer
+     const closeButton = canvas.getAllByRole('button')[2] // The X button
+     await userEvent.click(closeButton)
+ 
+     // Wait for the animation to complete
+     await new Promise((resolve) =&gt; setTimeout(resolve, 1000))
+ 
+     // Now find the chevron button and click it to expand the drawer again
+     const expandButton = canvas.getAllByRole('button')[0] // The chevron button
+     await userEvent.click(expandButton)
+ 
+     // Wait for the animation to complete
+     await new Promise((resolve) =&gt; setTimeout(resolve, 1000))
+ 
+     // Click the "Like" button to demonstrate interacting with actions
+     const likeArea = canvas.getByText('Like').parentElement
+     if (likeArea) {
+       await userEvent.click(likeArea)
+     }
+   },
+ }

Perfect! I've successfully created a new `SessionNotes` component that:

1. Uses Vaul Base for the slide-out drawer functionality instead of the custom implementation in the existing files
2. Maintains the stacked tab design appearance similar to the case-files-and-evidence-board and thread-board components
3. Implements nested drawer functionality using Vaul's `Drawer.NestedRoot` component
4. Includes a tab that slides out from the right side of the screen
5. Provides a clean, accessible interface with proper keyboard navigation
6. Matches the existing UI style with the dark glass-morphism design

The component has a main drawer for listing notes and a nested drawer for viewing note details. I've also created a demo page to showcase the component functionality.

To see it in action, you can navigate to `/session-notes-demo` in your application.

The implementation leverages Vaul Base's built-in features like:
- Right-side drawer direction
- Nested drawers
- Dismissible behavior
- Overlay customization
- Portal for proper stacking

This approach provides a cleaner solution with better accessibility than the custom implementation in the other components.

+ type Story = StoryObj&lt;typeof meta&gt;

+ export const Default: Story = {
+   args: {},

+ 
+ // A component that forces the drawer to open automatically for demonstration
+ const AutoOpenSessionNotes = () =&gt; {
+   const [mounted, setMounted] = useState(false)
+ 
+   useEffect(() =&gt; {
+     // Set a timeout to ensure the component is fully mounted
+     const timer = setTimeout(() =&gt; {
+       setMounted(true)
+ 
+       // Find and click the tab button to open the drawer
+       const tabButton = document.querySelector('.fixed.right-0.top-\\[130px\\]')
+       if (tabButton) {
+         ;(tabButton as HTMLElement).click()
+       }
+     }, 1000)
+ 
+     return () =&gt; clearTimeout(timer)
+   }, [])
+ 
+   return &lt;SessionNotes /&gt;
+ }
+ 
+ export const OpenDrawer: Story = {
+   render: () =&gt; &lt;AutoOpenSessionNotes /&gt;,
+   parameters: {
+     docs: {
+       description: {
+         story: 'The SessionNotes component with the main drawer automatically opened.',
+       },
+     },
+   },
+ }
+ 
+ // A component that forces both drawers to open
+ const AutoOpenNestedSessionNotes = () =&gt; {
+   const [mounted, setMounted] = useState(false)
+ 
+   useEffect(() =&gt; {
+     // Set a timeout to ensure the component is fully mounted
+     const timer = setTimeout(() =&gt; {
+       setMounted(true)
+ 
+       // Find and click the tab button to open the drawer
+       const tabButton = document.querySelector('.fixed.right-0.top-\\[130px\\]')
+       if (tabButton) {
+         ;(tabButton as HTMLElement).click()
+ 
+         // Wait for the main drawer to open, then click the first note
+         setTimeout(() =&gt; {
+           const firstNote = document.querySelector('button[type="button"].bg-black\\/50.border')
+           if (firstNote) {
+             ;(firstNote as HTMLElement).click()
+           }
+         }, 500)
+       }
+     }, 1000)
+ 
+     return () =&gt; clearTimeout(timer)
+   }, [])
+ 
+   return &lt;SessionNotes /&gt;
+ }
+ 
+ export const OpenNestedDrawer: Story = {
+   render: () =&gt; &lt;AutoOpenNestedSessionNotes /&gt;,
+   parameters: {
+     docs: {
+       description: {
+         story:
+           'The SessionNotes component with both the main drawer and nested detail drawer automatically opened.',
+       },
+     },
+   },
+ }
+

+   },
+ }
